subject: Widening demo roster — need new slot for security & procurement
messages:
From: Alex Romano <alex.romano@novara-systems.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Priya Bhatnagar <priya.b@novara-systems.com>, Novara Procurement <procurement@novara-systems.com>
Date: Sat, 22 May 2027 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Widening demo roster — need new slot for security & procurement

Hi Ben / Marissa,

Quick update from our side: we just added a couple of stakeholders who need to attend the demo — Priya (our CISO) and the procurement lead — and their calendars are pretty constrained. I’m also traveling the original week (out May 24-26), so the May 24 slot won’t work for me.

High-level asks:
- Can we move the demo to a new window next week so security & procurement can join?
- Would prefer a 60–90 minute slot so we can walk through controls and procurement-level commercial topics.
- If you have a short checklist or MAP and a draft SOW we can review in advance, that’d help speed procurement.

I’ve attached an internal attendee list and our procurement contact details.

Attachments: Novara-MAP-v2.pdf

Thanks,
Alex
Alex Romano
VP, Platform Partnerships | Novara Systems
alex.romano@novara-systems.com
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Romano <alex.romano@novara-systems.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com>, Novara Procurement <procurement@novara-systems.com>
Date: Sat, 22 May 2027 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Widening demo roster — need new slot for security & procurement

Thanks for the heads-up Alex — appreciate the notice.

We can absolutely widen the audience and block a longer window. A couple quick notes / asks from our side:
- We can run 90 minutes and split it: ~40 min product + 30 min security deep-dive + 20 min procurement/Q&A.
- Can Priya confirm if she wants architecture/networking details (VPC, peering, encryption keys) or a compliance summary (SOC2, logs, attestations)? We’ll prepare both but will tailor to her ask.
- I’ve looped in Karthik (SE) and Marissa (solutions) to lead the session; Grace will cover onboarding and CS questions.

Proposed new windows (all PT):
- Tue May 28, 11:00–12:30
- Wed May 29, 09:00–10:30
- Thu May 30, 14:00–15:30

We’ll also drop a draft SOW and a short SOC2 summary in Drive before the meeting. Can procurement confirm which of those times works and whether they need a formal procurement worksheet or PO template ahead of the call?

Attachments to share from our side: Redwood-SOC2-summary.pdf, SOW-draft-Redwood.docx (will upload shortly).

–Ben
Ben Carter
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwoodinference.com
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Alex Romano <alex.romano@novara-systems.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, 22 May 2027 12:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Widening demo roster — need new slot for security & procurement

Alex — quick note on content so we can prepare the right artifacts:
- If Priya wants an architecture-focused deep-dive, I’ll bring a diagram of network flows, VPC options, and our tenant isolation model.
- If she wants compliance-level evidence, we’ll prepare the controls mapping (SOC2 scoping, retention, audit logs).

Either way, we should plan a 15–20 minute Q&A with Karthik on integration touchpoints (auth, SCIM/SAML, data residency), and 20 minutes with Grace on onboarding and timelines.

Preferred times for the internal team: Tue 11:00 or Wed 09:00 are best. Wed afternoon is tough due to an internal offsite.

I’ll start building a 30-min security appendix and request the SOC2 summary from Legal.

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
From: Novara Procurement <procurement@novara-systems.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Alex Romano <alex.romano@novara-systems.com>
Date: Mon, 24 May 2027 08:21:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Widening demo roster — need new slot for security & procurement

Hi Ben / Alex,

Thanks for the options. Procurement can join any of the proposed windows, but we do have two constraints:
1) We need the draft SOW and a redlines checklist at least 48 hours before the meeting.
2) We prefer to have commercial terms (term length, renewal, termination clauses) framed in a single doc for review.

Availability from our side (PT): Tue 28 11:00 OK; Wed 29 09:00 OK but prefer Tue.

Also, please include an attendee from Legal if the draft has vendor clauses that deviate materially; otherwise our procurement lead will handle initial redlines.

Procurement contact: procurement@novara-systems.com

Regards,
Novara Procurement
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Romano <alex.romano@novara-systems.com>, Novara Procurement <procurement@novara-systems.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 25 May 2027 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Widening demo roster — need new slot for security & procurement

Great — thanks for the quick reply and the clarity on procurement's needs. Per the thread above, we’ll lock Tue May 28, 11:00–12:30 PT.

Action items before the call:
- I will upload SOW-draft-Redwood.docx and Redwood-SOC2-summary.pdf to the shared Drive (link below) by EOD Tue so procurement has >48 hours to review.
- Marissa/Karthik will prepare the architecture + integration appendix; Grace will outline onboarding milestones and timelines.
- Ben to send calendar invite to this thread with 90-minute slot and an agenda.

Drive folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2b3C
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/9841

Ben — I’ll draft the invite and include a short agenda (product walkthrough, security appendix, procurement Q&A). Alex / Priya / procurement — say if you want Legal looped in now or after redlines.

Thanks — looking forward to aligning next week.

–Ben
